719-7487-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-7487-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-3147-8338.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Shuttlecraft Galileo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

339-677-1879-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-1879-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

222-527-4068-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4068-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
222-527-4068-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

789-2399-6495--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2399-6495--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Evereth by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
If the Evereth ability is not a mana ability, resolve those abilities now.
Repeat.
789-2399-6495--129.notes:
This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

2757-3327-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
2757-3327-6495.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.

728-3764-4871.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

240-3899-5470-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1170-5131-7753-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-7753-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

2113-3525-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it, adding {U}.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

433-1671-7857.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

2021-2060-3334-6774.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-7329-7704.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
539-3899-4552-7329-7704.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Mind Transfer Protocol
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

1978-5056-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
1978-5056-5457.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

1473-3487-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying its mana cost.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

3967-4215-5630-6872.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2577-4506-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-4506-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

5670-6634-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6634-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

104-360-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-360-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-6303-6520.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more opponents.
4050-6303-6520.notablePrerequisites: You control two creatures that do not have summoning sickness.
4050-6303-6520.description:
Declare two creatures you control as attackers, attacking two different opponents.
Holding priority, activate Nemesis Phoenix by paying {R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nemesis Phoenix, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1657-4419.description:
Cast Murderous Redcap by paying {2}{B/R}{B/R}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
When Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an amount of damage to itself equal to its power.
Murderous Redcap dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Murderous Redcap's persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat from step 2.

101-372-3306.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-3306.description:
Cast Slip On the Ring by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Slip On the Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Slip On the Ring.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

276-3011.notablePrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness
At least one opponent has an even life total
You have an odd life total
276-3011.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each player equal to half their life total, rounded down, then doubled.
Each player who started with an even life ottal loses the game for having 0 or less life.

28-2232-4033-5037-6073.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
28-2232-4033-5037-6073.description:
Activate Sadistic Hypnotist by sacrificing a creature, causing you to discard Basking Rootwalla and Blazing Rootwalla into exile.
Basking Rootwalla and Blazing Rootwalla's madness abilities trigger.
Resolve the Basking Rootwalla trigger, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
When Basking Rootwalla enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Angelic Sell-Sword trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Angelic Sell-Sword trigger, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Basking Rootwalla from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blazing Rootwalla trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Repeat steps 4 through 7 one additional time using Blazing Rootwalla instead.
Repeat from step 1.

1887-3774-4499-4554.description:
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Teferi.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Teferi, which enters the battlefield with ten loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing nine loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

955-1374-3626-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
955-1374-3626-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

141-1418-4176-4499.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U} available if Naru Meha is in your hand, or {4}{U} otherwise
141-1418-4176-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
141-1418-4176-4499.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting Karn's ability.
Holding priority, if Naru Meha is in your hand, cast it by paying {2}{U}{U}.
If Naru Meha is on the battlefield, activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control.
Repeat from step 4.
If you control four or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, which can be used to copy Vantress Visions infinitely targeting any other abilities on the stack, or to blink any number of creatures infinitely.

711-2113-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor and Pemmin's Aura attached to Fallowsage.
Fallowsage does not have summoning sickness.
711-2113-3525.description:
Activate Fallowsage by tapping it, adding {U}.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

731-2390-5299.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a counter on a permanent or player.
Corrupted Conscience attached to All Will Be One.
731-2390-5299.description:
Put a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, giving an opponent a poison counter.
Repeat step 2.

1872-2011-3328.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela is your commander and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Najeela.
1872-2011-3328.description:
Declare Najeela as an attacker, triggering itself and Ironsoul Enforcer.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ironsoul Enforcer trigger, returning Composite Golem from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
